unapp.best: A starter-based site edited in WordPress
unapp.copy: Unapp is our free block theme for the Site Editor, with nineteen niche starters and 232 inserter patterns. Choose a one-page or full website, add your business details and preview the result before applying it. The finishing workspace guides native content and image editing, while compatible section swaps and header/footer presets include preview and Undo.
unapp.limit: Shop requires WooCommerce; contact forms use an optional plugin or email links.

academia.standout: Six starters and a searchable course browser
academia.copy: Academia is our free block theme for schools, academies and course providers. Its six starters include school, university and online-learning layouts. A course browser presents courses from the free companion plugin or supported LMS plugins, with filtering and sorting that also work without JavaScript. Pages, navigation and styles are edited in WordPress's Site Editor.
academia.limit: The theme presents courses; lessons, enrolment and payments depend on the course plugin or LMS you choose.

pato.standout: Six food-business starters and reservation requests
pato.copy: Pato is our free restaurant block theme with priced menus, opening hours, galleries and a reservation-request form. Six starters cover a bistro, fine dining, cafe, pizzeria, bar and bakery. Menu items remain ordinary editable blocks, so changing a dish or price does not require a menu-builder plugin.
pato.limit: Reservation requests are sent for confirmation; the theme is not a table-inventory or payment system.

unioncorp.standout: Services, case studies and an enquiry form
unioncorp.copy: Unioncorp is our free block theme for consultancies, financial advisers and service firms. Service cards, case studies, pricing, testimonials and team sections provide a clear route to an enquiry. Its block edition includes an enquiry form, visitor dark mode and eight color palettes, all edited through WordPress's native tools.
unioncorp.limit: It is a marketing site theme, rather than a client portal, accounting system or financial-data service.

dreamrs.standout: Project filtering and editable property showcases
dreamrs.copy: Dreamrs is our free block theme for architecture studios, developers and estate agencies. It combines a photograph-led introduction with category-filtered projects, property facts, testimonials and a contact path. The block edition includes contact and newsletter forms, eight palettes and native Site Editor templates.
dreamrs.limit: Its showcase sections are editable content; it does not supply an IDX or MLS feed.

daren.best: An image-led personal blog or magazine
daren.standout: Story layouts populated by real posts
daren.copy: Daren is our free block theme for a personal journal or design-led magazine. Tall and wide photographs, alternating story layouts and category cards draw from the posts you publish. The block edition includes contact and newsletter forms, eight palettes and visitor dark mode, with templates editable in the Site Editor.
daren.limit: Supply your own featured images and categories; it is a publishing theme rather than a business starter library.

creative-agency.standout: Project pages and a bold services-led layout
creative-agency.copy: Creative Agency is our free block theme for studios and independent creatives. A large opening statement leads into staggered projects, services, client logos and studio imagery, with a contact form in the block edition. Projects have room for their own pages, and six palettes and native Site Editor controls let you adapt the presentation.
creative-agency.limit: The demo content needs your own projects and images; the block and Elementor editions are separate choices.

horseclub.standout: Lesson requests, training and membership sections
horseclub.copy: Horseclub is our free block theme for riding schools, livery yards and equestrian clubs. Training courses, events, membership plans, reviews and a gallery sit alongside a lesson-booking request form. The block edition uses native editing, includes eight palettes and does not need a form plugin for those requests.
horseclub.limit: Lesson requests need confirmation; the theme does not manage live instructor or stable availability.

montana.copy: Montana is our free hospitality block theme for hotels, lodges and mountain resorts. Its room sections show prices and facts, alongside offers, dining information and a photograph-led introduction. The block edition includes a room-request form with arrival and departure dates, eight palettes and visitor dark mode.
montana.limit: It collects booking requests; live room inventory, confirmed reservations and payments need a separate service.

industry.standout: Services, sectors, project imagery and quote requests
industry.copy: Industry is our free block theme for manufacturers, engineering contractors and construction firms. Service and sector cards explain the work, project imagery shows it, and the block edition includes a quote-request form. Native templates, eight palettes and dark mode provide the design controls without a page builder.
industry.limit: It presents services and collects enquiries, rather than managing estimates, work orders or procurement.

wemeet.standout: Countdown, speakers and a multi-day schedule
wemeet.copy: Wemeet is our free conference block theme with an event countdown, an Add to your calendar file, speakers, a tabbed multi-day schedule, venue information and ticket cards. The block edition includes ticket-enquiry and contact forms, plus eight palettes and native Site Editor templates.
wemeet.limit: Ticket enquiries are not ticket checkout; connect a separate ticketing destination when you want to sell admission.

docmed.copy: Docmed is our free medical block theme for clinics and small practices. Department cards, a doctor carousel, team pages and patient-information sections explain the practice before an appointment request. The block edition's header opens a request form with department, doctor and preferred date/time fields, with native editing and eight palettes.
docmed.limit: Requests need confirmation; the theme does not provide live appointment scheduling or patient records.

sunshine.standout: Wedding countdown, timings and RSVP requests
sunshine.copy: Sunshine is our free wedding block theme for a couple's own website. Names, a photograph and the date lead into a countdown, the story, a gallery, the day's timings and accommodation information for guests. The block edition includes RSVP and contact forms, eight palettes and native Site Editor templates.
sunshine.limit: It suits a single wedding; it is not an event-planning CRM or a paid ticketing service.

lagoon.copy: Lagoon is our free block theme for freight forwarders, hauliers and logistics firms. Road, sea and air services lead into a freight-quote request and an ask-about-a-shipment form. The block edition also includes testimonials, a journal, eight palettes and visitor dark mode, with all layouts edited in WordPress.
lagoon.limit: Shipment questions go to a person; the theme does not provide live carrier tracking or a freight-pricing API.

nonprofit.copy: Nonprofit is our free charity block theme with causes, progress figures, volunteering and ways to support. Its block edition includes pledge, volunteer, contact and newsletter forms, plus eight palettes and native Site Editor templates. Donate buttons can point to the organisation's actual giving destination.
nonprofit.limit: Progress figures are entered by the organisation; the theme does not process payments or provide recurring donations.

martine.copy: Martine is our free travel-agency block theme with destination imagery, tour cards and a day-by-day itinerary page. Tour information includes duration, group size, highlights, departures and a price-from field. The block edition includes tour-enquiry and contact forms, eight palettes and visitor dark mode.
martine.limit: It is an enquiry-led travel site; live availability, confirmed bookings and payments need another service.

south.best: Estate agents with real property listings
south.standout: A free listings plugin and filterable property search
south.copy: South is our free real-estate block theme. Its free South Listings companion plugin stores property prices, rooms, areas, addresses, galleries and agents as structured fields, and visitors can filter, sort and page through the results. The theme adds property layouts, agent information, enquiry forms, eight palettes and native editing.
south.limit: Use South Listings for the structured search. It does not include a live MLS or IDX feed.

tyche.best: A store edited with native WooCommerce blocks
tyche.standout: Six shop starters and ten palettes
tyche.copy: Tyche's current block edition is our free WooCommerce theme with six shop starters, ten palettes and seven typography pairings. Store, product, cart and checkout layouts use WordPress's Site Editor and WooCommerce blocks. It is a complete store design rather than a brochure homepage with a shop link added.
tyche.limit: Requires WordPress 7.0 or newer and WooCommerce. Check the migration guide before switching an older Tyche site.

philosophy.best: A masonry blog with native editing
philosophy.standout: Masonry posts and a choice of classic or block editing
philosophy.copy: Philosophy is our free masonry blog theme, available in classic and block editions. The block edition puts templates, the header and footer in the Site Editor while keeping the image-led post grid. It renders a usable grid before its small layout script enhances the columns, with self-hosted fonts and style variations.
philosophy.limit: Classic and block editions are separate themes; their settings do not transfer automatically.
